# Core Summary
A cinematic Star Wars-style lightsaber duel unfolds in a dimly lit metallic hangar between a female Jedi in white wielding a yellow blade and a hooded Dark Side warrior in black armor with a red blade. The clip follows a three-shot progression: opening with a dynamic wide shot of an aerial dodge, cutting to a mid-air deflection showering sparks, and concluding with a landing and counter-attack lunge. The visual style emphasizes high-contrast lighting, volumetric hangar fog, and photorealistic energy effects with dramatic lens flares.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:03] A vast, dimly lit metallic hangar bay with high ceilings and industrial support beams. The floor is grated steel, reflecting faint ambient light. Dust motes float in volumetric shafts of light piercing the darkness.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Same hangar environment, tighter framing focusing on the central combat zone. Background details blur slightly due to depth of field, emphasizing the foreground action.
[shot3][00:06-00:10] Same hangar environment, wider angle to capture movement across space. A suspended cargo crate is visible in the mid-ground, serving as a platform. Lighting flickers slightly from energy discharges.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female, young adult, East Asian. Athletic build. Wears a pristine white tunic with layered fabric and leather utility belts. Long dark hair tied back in a practical braid. Wields a yellow lightsaber.
<ID_B>: Male, adult, race obscured by armor. Tall, imposing build. Clad in heavy matte black armor with a deep hood obscuring the face. Wields a red lightsaber.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:03] Low-angle wide shot. <ID_B> stands right, swinging a red lightsaber downward in a brutal overhead smash. <ID_A> stands left, initiating a graceful Ataru-style backflip to dodge. The red blade misses by inches, striking the metal floor. Heavy metallic impact sound as the red blade hits the floor. Yellow and red lightsaber hums resonate deeply.
[shot2][00:03-00:06] Medium close-up, slow-motion feel. <ID_A> is mid-air, body twisted. <ID_B> follows up with a horizontal slash. <ID_A> raises her yellow lightsaber, deflecting the red blade. Bright orange sparks shower outward from the clash point. High-pitched energy sizzle and crackle sync with the spark burst.
[shot3][00:06-00:10] Dynamic tracking shot. <ID_A> lands lightly on a suspended cargo crate in the center. She immediately springs forward, lunging with rapid thrusts. <ID_B> retreats backward, blocking desperately. Footsteps thud on metal crate. Rapid whooshes of lightsaber swings fill the audio space as <ID_B> is forced back into the shadows.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Photorealistic cinematic style inspired by space opera epics. High contrast lighting: deep shadows in the hangar contrasted by the luminous glow of yellow and red lightsabers. Color palette dominated by metallic greys, stark white, matte black, and vibrant energy colors. Dramatic lens flares occur during blade clashes. Motion blur enhances the velocity of the duel. Volumetric fog adds depth to the dim environment.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
Tense, epic, and high-stakes. The atmosphere is charged with imminent danger and kinetic energy. The contrast between the pristine white Jedi and the dark armored warrior visually reinforces the light vs. dark thematic conflict. The pacing is rapid and intense, conveying a life-or-death struggle.
